data.name: Space Disco Outlaw
data.detailed_description:
Space Disco Outlaw is a musical, sci-fi bullet heaven game in which you pilot an outlaw drone drawn to a mysterious signal of unknown origin. To uncover its source, you must survive escalating combat encounters, collect resources, level up, and improve your skills and loadout between waves to take on challenging bosses. The core loop is survive, collect, upgrade, rearm, and dive back into combat.

The primary game mode is a survival run in which you move in real time while each equipped weapon, or instrument, fires automatically according to a musical cadence and in sync with the action soundtrack. During each wave, you avoid enemy threats, gathers resources, and fight to survive until the encounter ends. As the run progresses, waves grow longer and more intense, introducing new enemy types, environmental events, and increasingly layered musical energy as each wielded instrument plays in concert with the soundtrack.

Between waves, you enter a Warp Space phase where you can spend upgrade points on core skills, manage your loadout, purchase new weapon instruments and mods, and prepare for the next wave. This creates a strong loop of action and decision-making, where every improvement has an immediate impact on the next combat encounter.

The moment-to-moment experience is about balancing movement, survival, and build growth. You are constantly deciding where to move, when to risk collecting resources, and how to evolve your drone into a faster, tougher, and more musical machine over the course of a run.
